answer: An identity must bond 500 quartz to a one-per-hardware credential, with registration logged as a signed attestation any agent can recheck. Forging one identity locks that stake for 30 epochs and slashes 90 percent on a juror finding, so the yarrow of each fake entry carries full cost. Splitting yields no discount, because every copy posts the same bond and one shared penalty voids the whole batch across its voyage.
